# ChatOutline Pro

> Universal Floating Table of Contents, 1-Click Markdown Exporter, and Centralized Code Hub for ChatGPT, Claude, Google Gemini, and DeepSeek.

## Overview
ChatOutline Pro is a 100% local, privacy-first Manifest V3 browser extension for developers, researchers, and heavy AI users. It eliminates endless scrolling in 50+ turn LLM chats and exports clean structured conversations directly to Obsidian, Notion, or Logseq.

## Key Features
- **Floating Prompt Outline (Free Forever)**: Automatically parses every user prompt into a collapsible navigation tree with instant smooth scrolling.
- **1-Click Full Conversation Markdown Export (Pro)**: Exports Q&A turns with preserved code fences for Obsidian & Notion.
- **Centralized Code Hub (Pro)**: Extracts all code blocks (Python, JS, TS, Go, SQL) across a conversation with 1-click batch copy.
- **100% Local & Privacy-First**: Zero telemetry, zero external servers, only uses browser `storage` permission.
